headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWordLaw_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ) (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
  (R : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k fallback R =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryLaw r c U L hr hc start h k fallback R

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWord_accuracy_of_success
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
              ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ)
                (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
                ∀ s ≤ 1 - (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectedLaw r c U L).mass none,
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWordLaw r c U L hr hc start h k fallback R)
                      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
                    (1 - s) ^ R + ↑R * (Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic k)
